title: Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin The dollar and Bitcoin are both rising—a bullish sign, says Build Asset Management's Matt Dines. He breaks down the shift to a new US-led monetary order. This post Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
